name: Unconsolidated-deposit aquifer
note: Loess, flood deposits, alluvium; relatively high pore-space flow.

name: Upper confining unit
note: Fine interbeds and weathered material limiting vertical leakage.

name: Saddle Mountains Basalt aquifer
note: Youngest CRBG basalt aquifer; more discontinuous than deeper units.

name: Mabton/interflow confining unit
note: Sedimentary interbed and lower-permeability flow interiors.

name: Wanapum Basalt aquifer
note: Important Odessa aquifer; flow concentrated in interflow zones.

name: Vantage/interflow confining unit
note: Regional interbed/confining interval between Wanapum and Grande Ronde.

name: Grande Ronde Basalt aquifer
note: Deep, laterally extensive CRBG aquifer targeted by pumping wells.

name: Pre-Miocene older bedrock
note: Basement confining unit below the regional basalt aquifer system.
